authoritative_for: Mantic owns current named configs, exclusive expense-item ownership, validated fixed expense schedules, checked integer-cent forecasts, private-state initialization, and matched program/provider installation.
not_authoritative_for: Callers supply amounts, dates, definitions, edit authority, currency interpretation, and output-retention decisions. Mantic does not observe actual accounts, expense occurrence, or payment status.

covers: All supported public Mantic CLI outcomes for initialization, config and item management, transient forecasts, direct installation, deployment setup, inspection, retained-release selection, and usage inventory registration in this release.
excludes: Help/version, implementation helpers, direct SQLite integration, income rules, variable amounts, payment tracking, run or balance retention, bank access, models, daemons, and scheduling.

shared_access_and_trust: Interfaces are local-user CLI and filesystem operations. Reading a config or catalog does not authorize changing it.
shared_privacy_and_retention: One private database retains only current config definitions and schema metadata; edits replace definitions without history. Forecast inputs, occurrences, results, and balances are not retained. Caller-selected stdout destinations are outside Mantic retention.
Optional Chancery usage contains command identity, observation time, and thread correlation, with no arguments, bodies, output, or outcome.
compatibility_and_retirement: Product release 0.1.0, persistent schema one, CLI output schema one, provider schema four, and entry contract versions have independent meanings. Ordinary commands reject unsupported state without automatic migration.
operational_limits: Amounts use signed 64-bit integer cents and two decimal places. Expense amounts are positive. Calendar dates are 0001-01-01 through 9999-12-31, and one forecast selects at most 100,000 occurrences. No wall-clock, database-capacity, or future migration-window objective is promised.
